free_tier.stated: translated from the CNB pricing table: cloud-native build CPU free quota 160 core-hours a month; cloud-native development CPU free quota 1,600 core-hours a month; both GPU lines 0 core-hours a month; GPU overage at CNY 0.5 per core-hour; repository storage 100 GiB; object storage 100 GiB; 500 AI credits a month. A core-hour is cores multiplied by hours, so 1,600 core-hours is 200 hours on an 8-core node and 1,600 hours on a 1-core node.

egress.terms: not published: the billing table on the pricing page lists repository storage, object storage, build and dev CPU and GPU core-hours and AI Credits, and no egress or traffic item

record.interface_detail: REST (OpenAPI at api.cnb.cool), Git over HTTPS with an access token, and the browser cloud IDE; Git over SSH is documented as unsupported
record.tooling: a Git client over HTTPS (username cnb, an access token as the password); the REST OpenAPI at api.cnb.cool; the CNB CLI (command cnb, npm package @cnbcool/cnb-cli or Docker image cnbcool/cnb-cli, login by OAuth2 device flow or the CNB_TOKEN variable)
record.chaining: 1,600 CPU core-hours a month runs a continuous build and test loop for a single developer, and it holds the build step of any chain whose GPU step has moved elsewhere.

limits.value: 160 core-hours a month of build CPU and 1,600 core-hours a month of development CPU, both reset at month end and never carried over; both GPU lanes are 0 core-hours a month, so a job that needs a card bills at CNY 0.5 per core-hour from the first one.

record.limits_note: the build CPU allowance of 160 core-hours a month binds first, at 20 hours on an 8-core node; the development allowance of 1,600 core-hours is the larger lane, at 200 hours on the same node; both GPU lanes are 0 core-hours a month.
record.binding_note: the build CPU allowance of 160 core-hours a month binds first, at 20 hours on an 8-core node; the development allowance of 1,600 core-hours is the larger lane, at 200 hours on the same node; both GPU lanes are 0 core-hours a month.

identity_cost.detail: a WeChat account and a phone number. The help centre says the real-name step authorises CNB to read the phone number bound to that WeChat account, and that an account without real-name verification may not write, by creating an issue for example. No page read states a country for the number, and whether a WeChat account with no mainland number passes is unverified.

record.provider: CNB 云原生构建 (cnb.cool, Tencent Cloud Native Build, community edition)

free_tier.stated: Per top-level org, free tier per month: '仓库存储 100 GiB' + '对象存储 100 GiB' (object storage covers '制品、LFS 对象、图片及附件'), plus 160 build-CPU core-hours and 1600 dev-CPU core-hours. Over-quota is metered at ¥1/GiB/month, and storage is billed on daily average minus the free allowance. So staying under 100+100 GiB per org is genuinely free.

egress.terms: Pricing table specifies 仓库存储 and 对象存储 by GiB-month without a separate egress traffic row. Public release-attachment downloads run through the cnb.cool CDN.

record.tooling: OpenList ships a first-class `cnb_releases` driver (github.com/OpenListTeam/OpenList, drivers/cnb_releases. Fields: repo, token, use_tag_name, default_branch), i.e. a maintained WebDAV/HTTP front end over CNB release attachments. Also the official `cnbcool/attachments` plugin ('支持 commit 和 release 上传或下载附件，目前暂支持 64GB 以内的文件上传') and a Rust CLI (`cnb release download/--share`).
record.chaining: Free allowance is per top-level organization ('每个顶级组织独立计费') providing 200 GiB each. Repositories support releases with attachments up to 64 GB per file.
record.limits_note: Per-object-cap: 64 GB per release/commit attachment (provider's own plugin README: '目前暂支持 64GB 以内的文件上传'). repo-blob cap: 256 MB per file in the git tree, with the maintainers explicitly steering large files to release attachments ('此256M之限制..当以附件方式为之'). request-rate: none documented. Billing: over the free 100 GiB the org is charged ¥1/GiB/month at month start. Silent overage, not a hard stop.

identity_cost.detail: national-id (WeChat login / 腾讯云 account; the docs' usage-management flow binds a Tencent Cloud budget). Not anonymous.

record.reliability_note: Community edition launched public beta 2025-08; beta-free extras expired 2025-08-31, so the 100+100 GiB figures are the steady state. No ban/wipe reports found; overage is billed rather than blocked, which is the real hazard.

evidence.proved: '仓库存储 | 100 GiB | ¥1/GiB/月 | Git 对象' and '对象存储 | 100 GiB | ¥1/GiB/月 | 制品、LFS 对象等'; '每个顶级组织独立结算'
'支持 commit 和 release 上传或下载附件，目前暂支持 64GB 以内的文件上传'
maintained driver with release-attachment upload/download, proving a working non-web client

record.notes: Per top-level org, free tier per month: '仓库存储 100 GiB' + '对象存储 100 GiB' (object storage covers '制品、LFS 对象、图片及附件'), plus 160 build-CPU core-hours and 1600 dev-CPU core-hours. Over-quota is metered at ¥1/GiB/month, and storage is billed on daily average minus the free allowance. So staying under 100+100 GiB per org is genuinely free.
